DevopsActivityLog.name: DevopsActivityLog
DevopsActivityLog.description: Represents the history of activities performed within DevOps Center. The object provides visibility into the users, actions, and outcomes.

Activity.description: A summary of the specific action performed.

ActivityDate.description: The date and time when the activity happened.

Description.description: Detailed information about the activity, such as commit comments.

DevopsRequestInfoId.description: The ID of the associated DevopsRequestInfo record that triggered this activity log entry.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record indirectly, for example, through a list view or related record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, and LastReferenceDate is not null, the user accessed this record or list view indirectly.

Name.description: A unique identifier for the activity log entry, typically with a DOAL- prefix.

OwnerId.description: The ID of the user or group that owns this record.

ParentActivityId.description: The ID of a parent activity log entry, used to group related sub-actions.

PerformedById.description: The ID of the user who performed the action.

PipelineId.description: The ID of the pipeline associated with this activity.

PipelineStageId.description: The ID of the specific pipeline stage where the activity occurred.

ProjectId.description: The ID of the DevOps Center project associated with this activity.

RequestInfoErrorDetails.description: Error details or logs retrieved from the associated request if the status is FAIL.

WorkItemId.description: The ID of the work item related to this activity.
